name: trailguide
description: Job search and resume tailoring that only rearranges what you've already written
author: Tara <1711810+taraxvoid@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.test:unit:precommit: env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_INDEX_FILE -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_PREFIX bun test --path-ignore-patterns='tests/{tailor,tailorRuns,runSearch,db}.test.ts'
scripts.test:push: env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_INDEX_FILE -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_PREFIX bun test
scripts.validate: bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test
scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo 'lefthook not installed (run mise install); git hooks skipped'
